articles.title: Wall Street Chiefs Split Over AI Boom as Financing Needs Reach Trillions
articles.excerpt: At a Hong Kong summit, Blackstone and the big banks backed the AI buildout while Pimco, Bain Capital and Franklin Templeton warned that spending and valuations are outrunning returns.

articles.title: Samsung Texas Plant to Make HBM Parts for AMD, Nvidia: Report
articles.excerpt: Samsung's second Taylor plant will reportedly produce HBM base dies for AMD and Nvidia using 2-nanometre technology, with mass production expected in 2030, Maeil reported — Samsung declined to comment.
articles.image_caption: Samsung's headquarters towers stand in Seoul, South Korea. A Maeil Business report says Samsung will make HBM chip parts for AMD and Nvidia at a second plant in Texas.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian-American engineers and investors in the U.S. semiconductor and AI sector, a reported U.S. source of HBM components for AMD and Nvidia in Texas is a direct supply-chain development to track.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Limits AI Coding Tools To Engineers Only
articles.excerpt: Internal guidance updated in October ends months of Claude Code and GitHub access for most bankers and traders, months after the bank's tech chief praised their 'vibe coding.'
articles.image_caption: The Goldman Sachs name is displayed on the glass facade of a company building. The bank has limited access to AI coding tools to its engineers under guidance issued in October.
articles.nri_angle: The limits reflect a Wall Street-wide recalibration of AI agents that Indian-origin bankers, traders and technologists across the U.S. will feel in their daily work.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Launches Dreambeans in India, Its First Market Outside US
articles.excerpt: The Google Labs experiment turns connected Calendar, Gmail, Photos, Search and YouTube activity into personalised illustrated stories, now in English and 13 Indian languages for users aged 18 and over.
articles.image_caption: Google's Dreambeans app in the company's launch artwork, showing an illustrated personal story on a phone. The Google Labs experiment has launched in India, its first market outside the United States.
articles.nri_angle: India is Dreambeans' first market outside the US, with 13 Indian languages, reflecting how central Indian users of Gemini, Gmail and Photos are to Google's AI experiments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Apple's Foldable iPhone Duo Screens Are Cracking Within Hours, Owners Say
articles.excerpt: Early buyers of the $1,999 iPhone Duo report inner displays splitting along the fold with an audible snap. Apple says a small number of units are affected and is replacing them through AppleCare, without naming a cause or a count.
articles.image_caption: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo in a product image, showing the inner display partly open. Some owners report the inner screen cracking within hours or days of use, and Apple says it is replacing affected units under AppleCare.
articles.nri_angle: The Duo sells in India from Rs 2,99,900 with grey-market premiums reported, so Indian buyers face the same cracking reports and possible replacement waits as US owners.

articles.title: A Thermodynamic Boundary Shows How Organic Solar Cells Can Lose Less Voltage
articles.excerpt: By testing five donor materials against 15 acceptors, a Chiba University-led team found the energy point at which organic cells keep their current while shedding less voltage — and that stiffer donor molecules help them sit there.
articles.image_caption: A transparent flexible organic solar module is held up to the light. A Chiba University-led study identified an energy boundary that could help such cells generate current while losing less voltage.
articles.nri_angle: Organic photovoltaics are a field where Indian research groups and diaspora scientists are active; a clearer design rule for cutting voltage losses matters to anyone tracking where lightweight solar goes next.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Marvell to Buy Lumentum in $115 Billion All-Stock Bet on AI Optical Connectivity
articles.excerpt: Lumentum holders get a fixed 4.500 Marvell shares per share, a 23.9% premium, in a deal the companies say creates a category leader for AI data-center connectivity, with closing expected in the first half of 2028.
articles.nri_angle: A landmark US chip deal that reprices the AI supply chain Indian IT and semiconductor investors track closely.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Expects 3,000 or Fewer Takers for Exit Offer Open to 60,000 Staff
articles.excerpt: The voluntary offer covers staff in India, the US, Canada and the UK at level 70 and below; India employees are reported to have until December 1 to decide.
articles.image_caption: An aerial view of Microsoft's West Campus. Microsoft's voluntary exit offer is open to about 60,000 eligible employees in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States.
articles.nri_angle: Microsoft's 23,000-strong India workforce — Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Noida hubs full of diaspora-linked tech families — is squarely inside the offer's scope.

articles.title: Windows 11 Gains Cloud Rebuild: Reinstall From the Cloud Even When the PC Won't Boot
articles.excerpt: The KB5127936 preview update downloads a Windows image and your drivers from Windows Update — no USB stick needed — but it wipes the system disk, so read the warning first.
articles.image_caption: A graphic shows a laptop beneath a cloud carrying the Windows logo. Cloud rebuild reinstalls Windows 11 using an image and drivers downloaded from Windows Update, even when the PC cannot start.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora tech workers and the family members who are their default IT support, a no-USB rebuild makes rescuing a parent's dead PC a phone-guided job.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.step: Install the optional KB5127936 preview update
steps.detail: Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Optional updates. The feature rolls out gradually, so it may not appear immediately.

steps.step: Back up anything stored only on the PC
steps.detail: Cloud rebuild reformats the system disk and removes all local files, accounts, apps and settings. Cloud-stored files are unaffected.
If the PC boots: Settings > System > Recovery > Rebuild PC. If it does not: in WinRE, choose Troubleshoot > Recovery and uninstall > Cloud rebuild.
Join Ethernet or Wi-Fi, review the target build, edition and language, and confirm the data-loss warning. Keep the PC plugged in.
"Remove files" is faster; "Remove & sanitize files" is irreversible and is the right choice before selling or handing on the PC.

articles.excerpt: Endorsing a Cambridge professor's New York Times essay, the Zoho co-founder says India should shift from MBA schools to startup incubators and venture creation.
articles.nri_angle: A leading Indian founder publicly questioning the MBA matters to diaspora families weighing expensive business degrees for their children.

articles.title: Two US Senators Give Sundar Pichai Until November 2 to Answer on Classroom AI
articles.excerpt: Josh Hawley and Richard Blumenthal have put nine questions to Google's chief executive about Gemini in schools, citing cases of students who leaned on AI for homework and emotional support.
articles.image_caption: Senators Josh Hawley and Richard Blumenthal at a Senate hearing in Washington. The pair wrote to Google CEO Sundar Pichai on October 21, demanding answers on AI in classrooms by November 2.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American families are heavy users of US public schools and Chromebooks; the senators' questions on default-on AI and opt-outs affect their children directly.

articles.title: DeepMind's AI Agent Hunts Drug-Resistant Bacteria and Surfaces a New Candidate
articles.excerpt: Using its Antigravity platform and the ProtNLM model, DeepMind biologists filtered millions of uncharacterized proteins to a single antimicrobial peptide lead — now in lab validation, with no results yet.
articles.image_caption: A researcher examines a protein structure on a laboratory screen. DeepMind's Antigravity platform searched millions of uncharacterized proteins to identify a candidate antimicrobial peptide.
articles.nri_angle: Antimicrobial resistance is a major health burden in India and for diaspora families; the story explains a new AI-led search method and its limits.

articles.title: Google's Suncatcher Satellite Answers First Prompt From Orbit With a Haiku
articles.excerpt: A Gemma 4 model running on a data-center-class TPU aboard Google's prototype satellite replied to a prompt from Earth — the first test of the company's plan to run AI computing in space.
articles.image_caption: Google's Project Suncatcher artwork, published with the company's research announcement. The project is testing whether Google's TPU AI chips can run computing workloads aboard solar-powered satellites in orbit.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced the milestone; the project is a long-term bet on moving AI compute off Earth.

articles.title: Chrome Can Now Pull Booking Codes and Order Numbers From Your Gmail
articles.excerpt: Google's Gemini-powered enhanced autofill suggests flight bookings, tracking numbers and order details from your inbox as you fill forms — US-only, opt-in, and easy to switch off.
articles.nri_angle: Frequent US-India travellers are among the heaviest users of flight booking codes and tracking numbers the feature is built to surface.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.detail: Use the three-dot menu, then Settings.
Select Enhanced autofill inside that section.

steps.step: Turn off 'Find and fill with Gemini'
steps.detail: This stops Gmail-based suggestions while leaving regular autofill intact.

articles.title: ISRO Launches NVS-03 Successfully, Restoring NavIC to Full Working Strength
articles.excerpt: GSLV-F18 placed the 2,232 kg navigation satellite in its intended orbit late on October 30, returning India's NavIC constellation to its four-satellite minimum and adding the smartphone-friendly L1 signal.
articles.image_caption: A second-generation NavIC satellite of the NVS series (file image). ISRO launched NVS-03, restoring NavIC to full working strength.
articles.nri_angle: NavIC's restored constellation and new L1 signal strengthen India's independent positioning system that diaspora travellers and devices increasingly rely on in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.nri_angle: AI chip demand is reshaping semiconductor jobs and investment flows that affect Indian technology workers and investors worldwide.

articles.excerpt: The new Pocharam block adds 10,000 seats and aims to support more than 13,000 additional employees under a hybrid model across a 450-acre campus.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian technology professionals abroad who collaborate with Hyderabad delivery teams, the expanded Pocharam campus adds capacity for global client work in AI, cloud and cybersecurity.

articles.title: SpaceX Fires Up Ship 42 as Flight 15 Targets First-Ever Starship Tower Catch
articles.excerpt: SpaceX has completed static-fire tests on both stages of Starship Flight 15 — a full six-engine burn and a single-engine deorbit rehearsal on Ship 42, after a 33-engine firing of Booster 22 — ahead of a November launch that aims to catch both stages at the tower.
articles.image_caption: Starship's Ship 42 upper stage stands on its test stand at Starbase, Texas, in a graphic marking its six-engine static fire. Ship 42 completed full-duration six-engine and single-engine static fires ahead of Flight 15.
articles.nri_angle: Starship's progress toward full reusability is closely watched by India's growing space sector and diaspora engineers across the US aerospace industry.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ISRO's NVS-03 Launch Tonight Aims to Restore NavIC's Standalone Positioning
articles.excerpt: GSLV-F18 is set to lift off at 11:51 p.m. IST on October 30 carrying NVS-03, which would take NavIC to four working navigation satellites — the minimum for standalone positioning — after years of clock failures and the NVS-02 setback.
articles.image_caption: A GSLV rocket stands on the launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. GSLV-F18 is scheduled to carry the NVS-03 navigation satellite into orbit on the night of October 30.
articles.nri_angle: NavIC is the positioning system India's phones, vehicles and defence users rely on as a home-grown alternative to GPS; its recovery affects services across India and 1,500 km beyond its borders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
